subject: 明代北方大民居，10×8格，五开间灰砖硬山住宅（原创扩展；细部待考）
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu default building-map, ONE isolated reusable game building cutout, true RGBA transparent background. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its realistic historical painted material quality, crisp detailed grey roof tiles, believable aged masonry and wood, natural muted colors and detail density. Do not copy its building or old camera inaccuracies. This is a new Ming-era northern Chinese prefectural-town building, original game design, NOT restoration of a named monument. Camera MUST be orthographic dimetric 2:1 ground projection, yaw 45 degrees elevation 30 degrees: ground edges exact +0.5 and -0.5 slopes, all verticals upright, no vanishing point. Main frontage faces screen lower left. Ground footprint must be a thin flat rectangular apron with clearly visible straight left-to-front and front-to-right edges, front base corner visible, no thick pedestal or surrounding street. Entire eaves, ground edge and short shadow fully inside square frame with 10 percent transparent margins. Sunlight screen upper left, short soft contact shadow screen lower right. Northern Ming hard-gable YINGSHAN roof: restrained straight ridge, grey clay concave and convex roof tiles, low subtle ridge terminals, solid masonry gable ends flush with verge eaves, not overhanging timber gables, EXPOSED GREY BRICK ALL walls, NO white or cream plaster, subdued dark timber lattice doors/windows; no Qing imperial decoration. No written characters, signboards, lettering, symbols, people, background scenery, sky, horizon, mountains, labels, watermark, checkerboard, opaque floor, exaggerated curved eaves, cartoon or toy-like stylization. Generate exactly ONE asset. Subject: LARGE ordinary northern Ming family home, footprint width10m along left-front edge by depth8m along front-right edge. One wide five-bay single-storey house, not a courtyard complex, with low flanking ear-rooms integrated in the same continuous rectangular home. Main plain double doorway, modest brick steps and three timber lattice windows. All walls exposed grey brick, NO cream or white plaster, no gable timber bands. Hard-gable grey tiled roof flush with brick gable wall, lower compact side roof. Restrained daily-life jar and basket tucked near doorway. Ground base perimeter visible. Exact base edges have screen slopes +0.5 and -0.5, width/depth ratio10:8. Do not duplicate the reference house: five-bay larger grey-brick northern home with distinct massing.
